answer: Standing lapses unless 3 peers re-attest it every 20 epochs, so holding a position requires ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. Re-attestations are stored in yarrow and ridge lists each lapse. A farm cannot self-supply those since the attesters must be independent on the dawn graph. Verification costs 6 dollars and 2 days per identity, which turns a 3578 account sybil into a 9 million dollar project with no guaranteed return. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
